states: Production frontend on a loopback fixture. Playwright 1.56.1; Chromium 141 desktop/light and touch-emulated WebKit 26 phone/dark.

Fourteen matched before/after pairs inspected natively: first check, slow first check, recovered SSO with the original return error, failed check, fresh retry, slow retry, and completion from a focused Help link.

The baseline spinner never offered recovery and the pending retry stayed disabled. After 10 seconds the same check can be restarted or left waiting; Help and both 44 px recovery targets remain in view at 320 px. Failed discovery stays unknown and does not select local sign-in or setup.
interactions: 208 baseline and 252 candidate assertions. Tab/Enter or touch restarted an actual held GET; the server observed cancellation and one replacement, without a document reload or a sign-in write. Fresh retries do not duplicate, and time alone does not send another request.

Focus stays on a pending retry, transfers to the access region if that control is removed, and follows the existing troubleshooting link when the user has tabbed to Help. A passive current result still shows its advertised SSO option and return error and navigates to the same fixture provider.
